WhatsApp voice notes you receive get a notification with their text. Tap to test it on a recording or a saved voice note.

Optional: give Parakeetype notification access to transcribe WhatsApp voice notes on this device. Parakeetype ignores notifications from other apps. If the switch is greyed out, allow restricted settings in Parakeetype\'s app info first.

Allow Parakeetype to send notifications. Transcriptions appear as notifications.
See how Parakeetype transcribes voice notes. Record a test message, or play a WhatsApp voice note on this phone and compare it with its text. Everything stays on this device and nothing is saved.

Record a message. Parakeetype saves it as a voice note in WhatsApp\'s format and transcribes it the same way as the voice notes you receive. The recording stays on this device and is deleted when you close this.
